name: replynodes
description: Research a company by domain and get competitor briefs for 1-5 named domains, via the ReplyNodes MCP server. Also converts pages to Markdown and pulls brand and logo data. Connects to https://mcp.replynodes.com/mcp. MCP tool calls require a ReplyNodes API key (free key includes 500 credits; plans from $19). Does not search for companies by market or category.

REPLYNODES_API_KEY.title: ReplyNodes API key
REPLYNODES_API_KEY.description: ReplyNodes API key (rn_test_* or rn_live_*). MCP tool calls require this key. A free key includes 500 credits; paid plans start at $19. Get a key at https://replynodes.com/auth.md.
